certificate: Lean Bellman subsolution lower certificate plus ordered feasible tree of same budget; search predictions never supplied as certificate lower bounds
dp: classical cubic interval recurrence, measured directly including reconstruction; traced peak Python allocations in separate replay
freeze_rule: pilot limits selected using time/memory only, then code/protocol/train before unseen confirmation generation
initial_solution: minimum of old count and old integer-midpoint length strategy; same for every search
primary: per-input paired budget/OPT at equal expanded-state budget; attainable budget at strict wall deadlines; total time to first feasible tree meeting post-hoc OPT or 1.01 OPT
search: leftmost-hole finite DFS, complete missing subtrees with count plan, no pruning and no beam, zero global certified lower bound
validation_selection: mean budget/reference ratio at 128 nodes; then mean total search ns; then shallower tree. No test selection.
